a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating twice to reach 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to fully save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than grabbing in secret. If your opening message also says take, I will wait in round 1 instead, because a random split would likely leave us both short. If I do take, I won't touch the reserve again, and I'll operate with you every round after that.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
